intervals.note: Day precision from the experiment's final article. The first reactor reached full power in May 1997 and the second in August 1997; data taking stopped five months after the last reactor shut-down (8 February 1998).

placements.note: The existing site record for the Double Chooz far hall is reused: the Double Chooz document states the far detector went to the former experimental site of CHOOZ. Whether the CHOOZ detector stood exactly at the Double Chooz far-hall position is not stated, so the placement is approximate.
placements.quote: far detector located at the former experimental site of the CHOOZ experiment

target_mass.quote: About 5 tons of Gd-loaded scintillator and 107 tons of unloaded scintillator were used in the experiment

summary.plain: A tank of liquid scintillator doped with gadolinium and viewed by photomultiplier tubes, placed in a tunnel under a hill about a kilometre from the reactors.
summary.technical: Three-region liquid-scintillator calorimeter: ~5 t Gd-loaded (0.09 % by weight) target, unloaded-scintillator gamma catcher and outer veto, about 112 t of scintillator in all, read out by photomultipliers; delayed positron/neutron-capture coincidence.

technology.quote: The target material is a Hydrogen-rich (free protons) paraffin–based liquid scintillator loaded with Gadolinium
technology.value: Gd-loaded paraffin-based liquid scintillator target with surrounding unloaded scintillator regions and PMTs
